note: fixed by c8342ea (test: tools/test/guards.test.mjs 'scopedPlanPath (the /ship scope gate) ... agrees with the hook on a missing one'). Outside a slot, scopedPlanPath returns activePlanPath(), which returns the .worktree-plan path even when that file no longer exists (on an orch/<run> branch that names no plan), while guard.mjs scopedPlan ignores a marker whose file is missing: /ship and the hooks disagree on which plan's scope applies.
